entities.summary: Abass Baraou is a German-French professional boxer who has held the World Boxing Association (WBA) light-middleweight title from 2025 to 2026. As an amateur, he won a bronze medal at the 2017 World Championships and a gold at the 2017 European Championships, both while competing at welterweight.
